chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله prayed the ẓuhr and ʿaṣr with the people when the sun had declined, in congregation, without any cause; and he prayed the maghrib and the later ʿishāʾ with them before the twilight disappeared, without any cause, in congregation. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله only did that so that the time might be made expansive for his Ummah.

key_terms.لِيَتَّسِعَ الْوَقْتُ: so that the time may be broadened and made easier
key_terms.مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلَّةٍ: without any special cause or excuse

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله combine prayers without an excuse?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله combined ẓuhr with ʿaṣr and maghrib with ʿishāʾ in congregation without any special excuse. It explains that he did so to provide ease and flexibility in prayer times for his Ummah, showing the breadth allowed in the performance of salat.
